```{r}
# Import the data sets and delete the two rows of junk text
col_names <- names(read_csv(here::here("data", "disagreement_exp3_raw_data.csv")))

raw_data <- read_csv(here::here("data", "disagreement_exp3_raw_dataa.csv"), 
                     col_names = col_names, skip = 3)

# Import the participant log (with notes, condition changes, etc.)
log_agree_data <- read_csv(here::here("data", "disagreement_monologue_agree_LOG.csv"), skip = 2) %>%
  # Make session time column a character because it is read in as a character in the disagree log, and they need to be the same type to combine
  mutate(`Session Time (enter twice - one row for each participant)` = 
          as.character(`Session Time (enter twice - one row for each participant)`))
log_disagree_data <- read_csv(here::here("data", "disagreement_monologue_disagree_LOG.csv"), skip = 2)

log_data <- bind_rows(log_agree_data, log_disagree_data)
```

```{r}
# Clean up the data

structured_data <- raw_data %>%
  # Filter out test responses and incomplete responses; the Feedback filters will save BOTH empty feedback AND feedback with text that does not say "Test"   
  # Finished == 1
  filter(Status == 0, toupper(Feedback) != "TEST" | is.na(Feedback) , !is.na(KnowOtherP),
         ID < 5000,  
         # Need to filter out those who didn't get the condition from the link, as they wouldn't have seen the right instructions in the survey
         !is.na(Agree_Condition), !is.na(Mode_Condition)) %>%
  mutate(mode_condition = factor(Mode_Condition),
         # Initialize column that will eventually have the CORRECT agreement condition (including the ones that were changed; keep the Agree_Condition variable with the original agreement condition)
         agree_condition = factor(true_agree_condition),
         orig_agree_condition = Agree_Condition,
         pol_orient = fct_recode(factor(PolOrient),
                                 "liberal" = "1",
                                 "liberal" = "2",
                                 "liberal" = "3",
                                 "middle" = "4",
                                 "conservative" = "5",
                                 "conservative" = "6",
                                 "conservative" = "7"),
         awkward_predict_reverse = 10 - awkward_predict,
         awkward_experience_reverse = 10 - awkward_experience,
         hostile_predict_reverse = 10 - hostile_predict,
         hostile_experience_reverse = 10 - hostile_experience,
         topic = factor(topic),
         true_partner_opinion_before = 0,
         true_partner_opinion_after = 0,
         composite_predict = (enjoy_predict + awkward_predict_reverse + learn_predict + 
                                hostile_predict_reverse) / 4,
         composite_experience = (enjoy_experience + awkward_experience_reverse + learn_experience + 
                                hostile_experience_reverse) / 4,
         humaniz_comp_predict = (intell_predict + thought_predict + rational_predict) / 3,
         humaniz_comp_experience = (intell_experience + thought_experience + rational_experience) / 3,
         # (*) This gives people's actual attitude change
         absol_attit_change = abs(opinion_after - topic_opinion_before),
         # Initialize column for correct sign of prediction to use later
         predict_correct_sign = 0,
         # Initialize column for correct comprehension checks to use later
         passed_comp_check = 0,
         # (*) This gives how different people thought their partner's opinion was to their own (as initially reported) before the conversation:
         own_predicted_other_before = abs(predict_attit_before - topic_opinion_before),
         # (*) This gives how different people thought their partner's opinion was to their own after the conversation (reported after the conversation):
         own_minus_other_after = abs(partner_attit_after - opinion_after),
         # This gives how different people thought their partner's opinion was to their own (as initially reported) after the conversation:
         own_predicted_other_after = abs(partner_attit_before - topic_opinion_before),
         abs_predict_attit_before = abs(predict_attit_before),
         # Prediction of partner's attitude after the convo, reported after the convo:
         abs_partner_attit_after = abs(partner_attit_after),
         # Prediction of partner's attitude BEFORE the convo, reported AFTER the convo:
         abs_partner_attit_before = abs(partner_attit_before),
         # (*) Perception/Prediction of partner's attitude change from before to after discussion
         perceived_other_attit_change = abs(predict_attit_before - partner_attit_after),
         # (*) Difference of absolute value in attitudes (before vs. after) to measure extremity
         extremity_attit_diff = abs(opinion_after) - abs(topic_opinion_before),
         # (*) Difference of absolute value in predictions of partner's attitude (before vs. after) to measure extremity
         extremity_guess_diff = abs(partner_attit_after) - abs(predict_attit_before),
         # initialize columns to reverse-code own attitudes, other's attitudes, and attitude predictions
         reverse_own_before = 0,
         reverse_own_after = 0,
         reverse_other_before = 0,
         reverse_other_after = 0,
         reverse_guess_before = 0,
         reverse_guess_after = 0,
         reverse_guess_before_supp = 0)


# Clean up log data
cleaned_log_data <- log_data %>%
  # Rename the variables with long names
  dplyr::rename(log_agree_condition = `Agreement Condition ("agree" or "disagree") (enter twice - one row for each participant)`,
                log_mode_condition = `Mode Condition ("monologue" or "dialogue")`,
                log_change_condition = `Did you change the Agreement condition? (Leave BLANK if no; if yes, simply enter the condition you changed it to - enter either "agree" or "disagree" exactly)`,
                ID = `Participant ID`,
                session_number = `Sesssion Number`,
                log_notes = `Enter notes here, e.g. did anything unusual happen while running this participant? Any reasons why the data might be invalid, etc.?`,
                #log_notes2 = X13,
                recording_length = `Length of Recording(s) from the Session in minutes (round to the nearest minute)`)

# Later add merge with log data
  # One pair of participants got assigned different topics by mistake, so will exclude
full_data <- left_join(structured_data, cleaned_log_data, by = "ID") %>%
  filter(session_number != 104)
```

```{r}
# Create column to determine if prediction of other's attitude is of "correct" sign based on agreement condition
for(i in seq_along(full_data$predict_correct_sign)) {
  if((full_data$topic_opinion_before[i] < 0 && full_data$agree_condition[i] == "agree" &&
     full_data$predict_attit_before[i] < 0) |
     (full_data$topic_opinion_before[i] > 0 && full_data$agree_condition[i] == "agree" &&
     full_data$predict_attit_before[i] > 0) |
     (full_data$topic_opinion_before[i] < 0 && full_data$agree_condition[i] == "disagree" &&
     full_data$predict_attit_before[i] > 0) |
     (full_data$topic_opinion_before[i] > 0 && full_data$agree_condition[i] == "disagree" &&
     full_data$predict_attit_before[i] < 0 )) {
    full_data$predict_correct_sign[i] = 1
  } else {
       full_data$predict_correct_sign[i] = 0
     }
}

# Fix a bunch of errors in ID / session numbers (e.g., P's who accidentally got the link with the same ID number as someone else)
# One pair (there were four ID = 137 & 138 pairs)
full_data[full_data$ResponseId== "R_1eG0Sv54DewRoDS", "ID"] <- 300
full_data[full_data$ResponseId== "R_1eG0Sv54DewRoDS", "session_number"] <- 150
full_data[full_data$ResponseId== "R_1nTIwSpJjqwATzP", "ID"] <- 301
full_data[full_data$ResponseId== "R_1nTIwSpJjqwATzP", "session_number"] <- 150
# Next pair (137 & 138)
full_data[full_data$ResponseId== "R_u7JRp9w6mkqycrD", "ID"] <- 302
full_data[full_data$ResponseId== "R_u7JRp9w6mkqycrD", "session_number"] <- 151
full_data[full_data$ResponseId== "R_1KeVfHB9oq4e1xJ", "ID"] <- 303
full_data[full_data$ResponseId== "R_1KeVfHB9oq4e1xJ", "session_number"] <- 151
# Next pair (137 & 138)
full_data[full_data$ResponseId== "R_1gHfZ9VGw7Nje9V", "ID"] <- 304
full_data[full_data$ResponseId== "R_1gHfZ9VGw7Nje9V", "session_number"] <- 152
full_data[full_data$ResponseId== "R_ZxWkYg1u4KuVwHL", "ID"] <- 305
full_data[full_data$ResponseId== "R_ZxWkYg1u4KuVwHL", "session_number"] <- 152
# Pair with two 31's (in the same session) (there's no ID = 32 in the dataset otherwise)
full_data[full_data$ResponseId== "R_1QsJa8625l4sf3w", "ID"] <- 32
# Two 53's - I can't tell where the second one's partner is based on the timestamps, but they did finish the study, so will just put it in it's own session
full_data[full_data$ResponseId== "R_3Rlyeqzp6mbkfr4", "ID"] <- 306
full_data[full_data$ResponseId== "R_3Rlyeqzp6mbkfr4", "session_number"] <- 153
# Two 90's - I can't tell where the first one's partner is based on the timestamps, but they did finish the study (and left a comment that "everything went smoothly"), so will just put it in it's own session
full_data[full_data$ResponseId== "R_33kg5yrFcgXa6yA", "ID"] <- 307
full_data[full_data$ResponseId== "R_33kg5yrFcgXa6yA", "session_number"] <- 154
# Two 110's - I can't tell where the first one's partner is based on the timestamps, but they did finish the study, so will just put it in it's own session
full_data[full_data$ResponseId== "R_2wGICC9U9v6ZrPS", "ID"] <- 308
full_data[full_data$ResponseId== "R_2wGICC9U9v6ZrPS", "session_number"] <- 155
# Two 173's - will put the single 173 (the second 173 - whose partner will get filtered out anyway as per below) in different session with different ID
full_data[full_data$ResponseId== "R_3G6qb5OA4nhnCUv", "ID"] <- 309
full_data[full_data$ResponseId== "R_3G6qb5OA4nhnCUv", "session_number"] <- 156
# Two 174's (one will be excluded due to wrong prediction sign anyway, but will relabel that one here because otherwise it will mess up the pairwise calculations of partner's attitude --> relabeling the one with the wrong prediction)
full_data[full_data$ResponseId== "R_10AgrGVXBC6kuzT", "ID"] <- 310
full_data[full_data$ResponseId== "R_10AgrGVXBC6kuzT", "session_number"] <- 157
# Two 175's and 176's (one 175 and one 176 will get excluded later anyway due to wrong prediction sign, but will relabel one PAIR of 175/176 because otherwise it will mess up the pairwise calculations of partner's attitude --> relabeling the first pair to be a different session/set of IDs, even though one of that pair will later get filered out, and one of the other pair will later get filtered out)
full_data[full_data$ResponseId== "R_3rNyfvhJlvTjgMa", "ID"] <- 311
full_data[full_data$ResponseId== "R_3rNyfvhJlvTjgMa", "session_number"] <- 158
full_data[full_data$ResponseId== "R_3O1uTVrZ9jEvTnz", "ID"] <- 312
full_data[full_data$ResponseId== "R_3O1uTVrZ9jEvTnz", "session_number"] <- 158


 full_data <- full_data %>%
   # Make sure they are in order of session so that transferring over the partner's opinion will work
  arrange(session_number)


# Create variables with partner's opinion on the selected topic before AND after interaction
for(i in seq_along(full_data$session_number)) {
  if(i < length(full_data$session_number) &&
     full_data$session_number[i] == full_data$session_number[i+1]) {
    full_data$true_partner_opinion_before[i] = full_data$topic_opinion_before[i+1]
    full_data$true_partner_opinion_after[i] = full_data$opinion_after[i+1]
  } else if(i > 1 && 
             full_data$session_number[i] == full_data$session_number[i-1]) {
    full_data$true_partner_opinion_before[i] = full_data$topic_opinion_before[i-1]
    full_data$true_partner_opinion_after[i] = full_data$opinion_after[i-1]
  } else {
    full_data$true_partner_opinion_before[i] = NA
    full_data$true_partner_opinion_after[i] = NA
  }
}

# Create variables with true difference in attitudes within each pair (before and after), and variables with accuracy of prediction of partner's attitudes
full_data <- full_data %>%
  mutate(abs_attit_diff_before = abs(true_partner_opinion_before - topic_opinion_before),
         abs_attit_diff_after = abs(true_partner_opinion_after - opinion_after),
         # Accuracy of prediction of partner's attitude BEFORE interaction
         accuracy_predict_before = abs(predict_attit_before - true_partner_opinion_before),
         accuracy_predict_after = abs(partner_attit_after - true_partner_opinion_after))


# Reverse code actual attitudes, partner's actual attitudes, and predicted attitudes based on whether they initially agreed with the statement or not
# Actual attitudes
for(i in seq_along(full_data$reverse_own_before)) {
  if(full_data$topic_opinion_before[i] < 0) {
    full_data$reverse_own_before[i] = full_data$topic_opinion_before[i] * -1
    full_data$reverse_own_after[i] = full_data$opinion_after[i] * -1
  } else {
    full_data$reverse_own_before[i] = full_data$topic_opinion_before[i]
    full_data$reverse_own_after[i] = full_data$opinion_after[i]
  }
}
# Partner's actual attitudes
for(i in seq_along(full_data$reverse_other_before)) {
  if (is.na(full_data$true_partner_opinion_before[i])) {
    full_data$reverse_other_before[i] <- NA
    full_data$reverse_other_after[i] <- NA
  } else if (full_data$true_partner_opinion_before[i] < 0) {
    full_data$reverse_other_before[i] <- full_data$true_partner_opinion_before[i] * -1
    full_data$reverse_other_after[i] <- full_data$true_partner_opinion_after[i] * -1
  } else {
    full_data$reverse_other_before[i] <- full_data$true_partner_opinion_before[i]
    full_data$reverse_other_after[i] <- full_data$true_partner_opinion_after[i]
  }
}
# Predicted partner's attitudes
for(i in seq_along(full_data$reverse_guess_before)) {
  if(full_data$predict_attit_before[i] < 0) {
    full_data$reverse_guess_before[i] = full_data$predict_attit_before[i] * -1
    full_data$reverse_guess_after[i] = full_data$partner_attit_after[i] * -1
    # FOR SUPPLEMENT: Prediction of partner's attitude from BEFORE conversation, made AFTER the conversation
    full_data$reverse_guess_before_supp[i] = full_data$partner_attit_before[i] * -1
  } else {
    full_data$reverse_guess_before[i] = full_data$predict_attit_before[i]
    full_data$reverse_guess_after[i] = full_data$partner_attit_after[i]
    # FOR SUPPLEMENT: Prediction of partner's attitude from BEFORE conversation, made AFTER the conversation
    full_data$reverse_guess_before_supp[i] = full_data$partner_attit_before[i]
  }
}


         
# Create separate dataset that includes those who got the attitude prediction question INCORRECT (for any supplementary analyses)
full_data_sign <- full_data

full_data <- full_data %>%
    # Exclude those who got the attitude prediction question incorrect (based on their assigned condition)
  filter(predict_correct_sign != 0) %>%
  # Mutate columns with difference variables of reverse-scored attitude measures
  mutate(reverse_guess_diff = reverse_guess_before - reverse_guess_after,
         reverse_other_diff = reverse_other_before - reverse_other_after)

```



```{r}
# Create separate data frames for prediction and experience measures, in order to combine them into one data frame with two rows per participant (for each of their observations)
# Add back in: -own_predicted_other_after,
# own_minus_predicted_other = own_predicted_other_before
prediction_only <- full_data %>%
  dplyr::select(-false_experience:-rational_experience, -awkward_experience_reverse,
                -hostile_experience_reverse, -composite_experience, 
                -humaniz_comp_experience, -own_minus_other_after, -abs_attit_diff_after,
                -own_predicted_other_after, -accuracy_predict_after, -reverse_own_after, -reverse_other_after,
                -reverse_guess_after) %>%
  mutate(perceived_initial_attit_diff = own_predicted_other_before) %>%
  dplyr::rename(false = false_predict,
         similar = similar_predict,
         enjoy = enjoy_predict,
         awkward = awkward_predict,
         awkward_reverse = awkward_predict_reverse,
         learn = learn_predict,
         hostile = hostile_predict,
         hostile_reverse = hostile_predict_reverse,
         like = like_predict,
         partlike = partlike_predict,
         connect = connect_predict,
         intell = intell_predict,
         thought = thought_predict,
         rational = rational_predict,
         composite = composite_predict,
         humaniz_composite = humaniz_comp_predict,
         perceived_attit_diff = own_predicted_other_before,
         actual_attit_diff = abs_attit_diff_before,
         accuracy_predict = accuracy_predict_before,
         reverse_own = reverse_own_before,
         reverse_other = reverse_other_before,
         reverse_guess = reverse_guess_before) %>%
  mutate(phase = "prediction",
         attitude_prediction_stage = "before")

# Add back in: -own_predicted_other_before,
# own_minus_predicted_other = own_predicted_other_after
experience_only <- full_data %>%
  dplyr::select(-false_predict:-rational_predict, -awkward_predict_reverse,
                -hostile_predict_reverse, -composite_predict, 
                -humaniz_comp_predict, -own_predicted_other_before, -abs_attit_diff_before,
                -accuracy_predict_before, -reverse_own_before, -reverse_other_before,
                -reverse_guess_before) %>%
  dplyr::rename(false = false_experience,
         similar = similar_experience,
         enjoy = enjoy_experience,
         awkward = awkward_experience,
         awkward_reverse = awkward_experience_reverse,
         learn = learn_experience,
         hostile = hostile_experience,
         hostile_reverse = hostile_experience_reverse,
         like = like_experience,
         partlike = partlike_experience,
         connect = connect_experience,
         intell = intell_experience,
         thought = thought_experience,
         rational = rational_experience,
         composite = composite_experience,
         humaniz_composite = humaniz_comp_experience,
         perceived_attit_diff = own_minus_other_after,
         actual_attit_diff = abs_attit_diff_after,
         perceived_initial_attit_diff = own_predicted_other_after,
         accuracy_predict = accuracy_predict_after,
         reverse_own = reverse_own_after,
         reverse_other = reverse_other_after,
         reverse_guess = reverse_guess_after) %>%
  mutate(phase = "experience",
         attitude_prediction_stage = "after")

monologue_data <- bind_rows(prediction_only, experience_only) %>%
  mutate(phase = factor(phase,
                        levels = c("prediction", "experience")))

```

```{r}
# For full_data_filter only, create another variable to indicate whether P's overestimated, underestimated, or were calibrated
full_data_filter <- full_data_filter %>%
  mutate(composite_diff = case_when(
    composite_predict > composite_experience ~ "overestimate",
    composite_predict < composite_experience ~ "underestimate",
    composite_predict == composite_experience ~ "calibrated",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

full_data_filter %>%
  dplyr::select(composite_predict, composite_experience, composite_diff)
```

```{r}
# Create data frames without NA values for analyses on attitude items (some P's had a partner who was excluded / not in the dataset, so we have to exclude those P's in order to compare each pair's true attitude differences)
full_data_attitude <- full_data_filter %>%
  filter(!is.na(abs_attit_diff_before), !is.na(abs_attit_diff_after))

monologue_data_attitude <- monologue_data_filter %>%
  filter(!is.na(actual_attit_diff))

# Create data frame with complete pairs only (in the above, there are some P's who don't have a partner in the dataset but they still have their partner's attitudes in their row because it was entered before they were excluded)
complete_pair_sessions <- full_data_attitude %>% 
  group_by(session_number) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(count = n()) %>% 
  filter(count == 2) %>%
  dplyr::select(session_number)

full_data_complete_pairs <- inner_join(complete_pair_sessions, full_data_attitude, by = "session_number")

monologue_data_complete_pairs <- inner_join(complete_pair_sessions, monologue_data_attitude, 
                                            by = "session_number")

# Also create a dataset that just filters out the three participants whose partners I couldn't find (because there were duplicate ID numbers that I changed, but I couldn't tell based on the timestamps who was paired with whom, so I just put them in their own sessions respectively - but IF they somehow got paired with someone of a different condition, good to check that results hold when excluding them for robustness)
monologue_exclude_unknown <- monologue_data_filter %>%
  filter(ID != 306, ID != 307, ID != 308)

# Create session-level data because actual differences should be the same for each pair, so want to do analyses at the pair level for that measure
# Need to create separate prediction and experience data frames and then combine to preserve the predictions and experiences
monologue_data_attit_session_predict <- monologue_data_attitude %>%
  filter(phase == "prediction") %>%
  distinct(session_number, .keep_all = TRUE)
monologue_data_attit_session_experience <- monologue_data_attitude %>%
  filter(phase == "experience") %>%
  distinct(session_number, .keep_all = TRUE)

monologue_data_attit_session <- bind_rows(monologue_data_attit_session_predict,
                                          monologue_data_attit_session_experience)

#full_data_complete_pairs %>% group_by(session_number) %>% dplyr::summarize(count = n()) %>% arrange(count)
```

```{r}
# New dataset where combine perceived post-conversation attitudes and actual post-conversation attitudes into one column (self vs. other, both after), as well as perceived and actual pre-conversation attitudes into one column
# --> We want only complete pairs for this one
dataset_self_post <- full_data_complete_pairs %>%
  dplyr::select(agree_condition, mode_condition, reverse_guess_after, reverse_guess_before, 
                session_number, ID) %>%
  dplyr::rename(reverse_after = reverse_guess_after,
                reverse_before = reverse_guess_before) %>%
  mutate(reverse_diff = reverse_before - reverse_after,
         measurement_type = factor("perceived"))

dataset_other_post <- full_data_complete_pairs %>%
  dplyr::select(agree_condition, mode_condition, reverse_other_after, reverse_other_before, 
                session_number, ID) %>%
  dplyr::rename(reverse_after = reverse_other_after,
                reverse_before = reverse_other_before) %>%
  mutate(reverse_diff = reverse_before - reverse_after,
         measurement_type = factor("actual"))

dataset_self_other <- bind_rows(dataset_self_post, dataset_other_post)
```

```{r}
# Plotting functions
plot_main <- function(data, dv) {
  data %>%
  group_by(agree_condition, mode_condition, phase) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean = mean(!!enquo(dv)),
                   upper = mean(!!enquo(dv)) + std.error(!!enquo(dv)),
                   lower = mean(!!enquo(dv)) - std.error(!!enquo(dv))) %>%
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = agree_condition, y = mean, fill = phase)) +
  facet_wrap(~mode_condition) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(1), color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.4, position = position_dodge(1)) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Agree", "Disagree")) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("white", "gray30"),
                      labels = c("Expectation", "Experience")) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(x = "Agreement Condition", fill = "Phase")
}

plot_attitudes <- function(data, dv) {
  data %>%
  group_by(agree_condition, mode_condition, phase) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean = mean(!!enquo(dv)),
                   upper = mean(!!enquo(dv)) + std.error(!!enquo(dv)),
                   lower = mean(!!enquo(dv)) - std.error(!!enquo(dv))) %>%
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = agree_condition, y = mean, fill = phase)) +
  facet_wrap(~mode_condition) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(1), color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.4, position = position_dodge(1)) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Agree", "Disagree")) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("white", "gray30"),
                      labels = c("Before", "After")) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(x = "Agreement Condition", fill = "Phase")
}

# Table for Means and SDs
means_table <- function(data, dv) {
  data %>%
    group_by(agree_condition, mode_condition, phase) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean = round(mean(!!enquo(dv)),2),
                   sd = round(sd(!!enquo(dv)),2))
}
```

```{r}
# COMPUTING MANUALLY, for PairID specifically
# Composite
var_pair <- VarCorr(composite_full_model)$session_number[1]
```

```{r}
# Simple correlations because some measures have singularity issues
# Need to get the pairings - ONLY use those in complete pairs for this
first_in_pair_pred <- monologue_data_complete_pairs %>%
  filter(phase == "prediction") %>%
  group_by(session_number) %>%
  slice(1)

first_in_pair_exper <- monologue_data_complete_pairs %>%
  filter(phase == "experience") %>%
  group_by(session_number) %>%
  slice(1)

second_in_pair_pred <- monologue_data_complete_pairs %>%
  filter(phase == "prediction") %>%
  group_by(session_number) %>%
  slice(2)

second_in_pair_exper <- monologue_data_complete_pairs %>%
  filter(phase == "experience") %>%
  group_by(session_number) %>%
  slice(2)

# Match up predictions (to make sure they're paired properly, just in case ordering gets off)
paired_pred <- left_join(first_in_pair_pred, second_in_pair_pred, by = "session_number")

# Match up experiences (to make sure they're paired properly, just in case ordering gets off)
paired_exper <- left_join(first_in_pair_exper, second_in_pair_exper, by = "session_number")

# Compute the correlations on the measures, separately for predictions and experiences, WITHIN each condition

# COMPOSITE, AGREE & MONOLOGUE
# expectations
cor_apa(cor.test(paired_pred$composite.x[paired_pred$agree_condition.x == "agree" & 
                                           paired_pred$mode_condition.x == "monologue"],
                 paired_pred$composite.y[paired_pred$agree_condition.x == "agree" & 
                                           paired_pred$mode_condition.x == "monologue"],
                 use = "complete.obs"))
# experiences
cor_apa(cor.test(paired_exper$composite.x[paired_exper$agree_condition.x == "agree" & 
                                           paired_exper$mode_condition.x == "monologue"],
                 paired_exper$composite.y[paired_exper$agree_condition.x == "agree" & 
                                           paired_exper$mode_condition.x == "monologue"],
                 use = "complete.obs"))

# COMPOSITE, AGREE & DIALOGUE
# expectations
cor_apa(cor.test(paired_pred$composite.x[paired_pred$agree_condition.x == "agree" & 
                                           paired_pred$mode_condition.x == "dialogue"],
                 paired_pred$composite.y[paired_pred$agree_condition.x == "agree" & 
                                           paired_pred$mode_condition.x == "dialogue"],
                 use = "complete.obs"))
# experiences
cor_apa(cor.test(paired_exper$composite.x[paired_exper$agree_condition.x == "agree" & 
                                           paired_exper$mode_condition.x == "dialogue"],
                 paired_exper$composite.y[paired_exper$agree_condition.x == "agree" & 
                                           paired_exper$mode_condition.x == "dialogue"],
                 use = "complete.obs"))

# COMPOSITE, DISAGREE & MONOLOGUE
# expectations
cor_apa(cor.test(paired_pred$composite.x[paired_pred$agree_condition.x == "disagree" & 
                                           paired_pred$mode_condition.x == "monologue"],
                 paired_pred$composite.y[paired_pred$agree_condition.x == "disagree" & 
                                           paired_pred$mode_condition.x == "monologue"],
                 use = "complete.obs"))
# experiences
cor_apa(cor.test(paired_exper$composite.x[paired_exper$agree_condition.x == "disagree" & 
                                           paired_exper$mode_condition.x == "monologue"],
                 paired_exper$composite.y[paired_exper$agree_condition.x == "disagree" & 
                                           paired_exper$mode_condition.x == "monologue"],
                 use = "complete.obs"))

# COMPOSITE, DISAGREE & DIALOGUE
# expectations
cor_apa(cor.test(paired_pred$composite.x[paired_pred$agree_condition.x == "disagree" & 
                                           paired_pred$mode_condition.x == "dialogue"],
                 paired_pred$composite.y[paired_pred$agree_condition.x == "disagree" & 
                                           paired_pred$mode_condition.x == "dialogue"],
                 use = "complete.obs"))
# experiences
cor_apa(cor.test(paired_exper$composite.x[paired_exper$agree_condition.x == "disagree" & 
                                           paired_exper$mode_condition.x == "dialogue"],
                 paired_exper$composite.y[paired_exper$agree_condition.x == "disagree" & 
                                           paired_exper$mode_condition.x == "dialogue"],
                 use = "complete.obs"))

paired_pred %>% filter(agree_condition.x == "disagree", mode_condition.x == "dialogue") %>% dplyr::select(composite.x, composite.y)
```

# Power Analysis


```{r}
#### Power Analyses Using doSim and doFit ####
library(lme4); library(simr)

# Fit a mixed linear model to the original data set
original_model <- lmer(composite ~ agree_condition*mode_condition*phase + (1|session_number) 
                       + (1|session_number:ID),
                      data = monologue_data_filter)
  
# Run ANOVA to confirm that the interaction term produces the same F statistics or p values that we report in the paper
anova(original_model)

# Perform a power calculation
nsim <- 1000
p_values <- NULL
for(i in 1:nsim) {
  new_data_set <- doSim(original_model) # Simulate a new version of the data set based on the original model
  new_model <- doFit(new_data_set,original_model) # Fit a new model to the simulated data set
  new_anova <- anova(new_model); new_anova # Perform ANOVA over the new model
  #print(new_anova); print(new_anova[7,4])
  new_p_value <- pf(new_anova[7,4],1,212,lower.tail=F) # Extract the p value of the interaction term (entry [7,4] in the ANOVA table) in the new model, using F(2, 195)
  p_values <- c(p_values,new_p_value) # Store the p value of the interaction term
}

sum(p_values<=.05)/length(p_values) # Compute the statistical power
```

```{r}
# IDs are 45, 162, 62, 105
  

raw_data %>%
  filter(Status == 0, toupper(Feedback) != "TEST" | is.na(Feedback) , !is.na(KnowOtherP),
         ID < 5000) %>%
  filter(ID == 45 | ID == 162 | ID == 62 | ID == 105) %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, topic_opinion_before, Agree_Condition, Mode_Condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean = mean(abs(topic_opinion_before)))

full_data %>%
  filter(session_number == 90 | session_number == 42 | session_number == 43) %>%
  dplyr::select(session_number, ID, topic_opinion_before, agree_condition, mode_condition) %>%
  group_by(agree_condition) %>%
  # take absolute value of opinions since just want extremity
  dplyr::summarize(mean = mean(abs(topic_opinion_before)))

# These are the two in session 104 that each got mistakenly assigned a different topic
structured_data %>%
  filter(ID == 207 | ID == 208) %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, topic_opinion_before, Agree_Condition, Mode_Condition) %>%
  group_by(Agree_Condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean = mean(abs(topic_opinion_before)))
# In responding in the letter, I combine these with the ones above, simply averaging to 5.00 for the disagree condition

full_data_sign %>%
  filter(predict_correct_sign == 0) %>%
  dplyr::select(session_number, ID, topic_opinion_before, agree_condition, mode_condition) %>%
  group_by(agree_condition) %>%
  # take absolute value of opinions since just want extremity
  dplyr::summarize(mean = mean(abs(topic_opinion_before)))


# Checking average attitudes on selected topic for the main dataset
monologue_data_filter %>%
  group_by(agree_condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean = mean(abs(topic_opinion_before)))
```
